prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent game sprite animation sheet, 8 stationary crouched shooting poses.
Use the supplied directional sniper sheet as the EXACT character identity and rendering reference: female sniper, red beret, brown ponytail, dark blue long coat with white fur collar, brown backpack, red canisters, black armored boots, long scoped sniper rifle and suppressor. Same illustrated game sprite style, proportions, and fixed overhead three-quarter camera.
Generate exactly 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS, 8 full-body sprites, requested 2048x1280 pixels, eight equal 512x640 cells. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no color backdrop or gradients.
Each row depicts a different world-facing direction, and four frames of stationary crouched shooting: aimed ready, tiny upper-body recoil, recovery, aimed ready. Crouch on one grounded knee with the other boot planted. Within each row copy the pelvis, knees, legs, boots and ground position precisely identically across all four frames. No walking or foot movement. Same scale and position in each cell; all parts including entire rifle stay fully inside their own cell with 12% clear transparent padding.
CRITICAL SCREEN-SPACE RIFLE DIRECTIONS, measured from breech toward muzzle:
TOP ROW: NNE, barrel at exactly -67.5 degrees on screen, mostly UP and a little RIGHT. Unit vector (+0.383,-0.924). For 100px barrel extension the muzzle must move 38px RIGHT and 92px UP. This is the new halfway direction between reference row1 straight UP and reference row2 UP-RIGHT45. View the character mostly from behind, slightly from its left-back side; keep natural held rifle visible with muzzle above and right of shoulder.
BOTTOM ROW: ENE, barrel at exactly -22.5 degrees on screen, mostly RIGHT and a little UP. Unit vector (+0.924,-0.383). For 100px barrel extension the muzzle must move92px RIGHT and38px UP. This is the new halfway direction between reference row2 UP-RIGHT45 and reference row3 horizontalRIGHT. Side/rear three-quarter view of the character, rifle extending prominently rightward with muzzle slightly above stock.
These are two DISTINCT intermediate directions. Neither row may be straight UP(-90), ordinary NE(-45), or horizontalRIGHT(0). Keep barrel and final suppressor axes at requested angle consistently throughout each row. Do not rotate the entire image: character turns in 3D in the world under the same fixed overhead camera, world vertical stays upright.
Four poses in each row retain physically shouldered rifle, hands attached naturally and same grounded lower body. Subtle recoil along firing axis only. Full-body silhouettes separated and no sprite touches another.
No muzzle flashes, smoke, projectiles, trails, particles, shadows, floor, UI, text, labels, grid lines or extra objects.
